fixtureMode: Real source uploaded into isolated local Document Studio storage; first seed uses the actual local prepare API and durable scene directory to compile/publish once. The seed is reported separately. Each measured pair uses a fresh browser context, clears Chrome's HTTP cache before cold full navigation, then reloads the same page/context for warm. Playwright request routing is absent. CAD API endpoints send no-store responses, so warm browser caching primarily applies to static app assets; the scene store and Next process stay warm after the seed. Raster capture hides every DOM sibling outside the canvas ancestor chain during the screenshot and restores inline visibility afterward; a synthetic full-screen overlay probe asserts that UI cannot contaminate the canvas PNG. The first meaningful raster sample is the earliest sampled frame with at least 100 foreground pixels and 2 occupied cells, and at least 10% of the settled foreground pixels and occupied cells. Raster snapshots are sampled at <=500 ms intervals until host chunk requests settle.

limits: The seed includes the first actual prepare/compile/publish and is excluded from the 30 measured cold/warm samples; phase-level decode/compile/publish timing is not independently instrumented. The measured service and Next process remain warm after the seed. Cold clears Chromium's HTTP cache before navigation; CAD API responses are private/no-store, so warm reload mainly reuses static app assets. First nonempty and first meaningful raster values are sampled upper bounds, not exact compositor-present timestamps; periodic PNG capture overhead is not isolated from the navigation interval. The meaningful-raster threshold is relative to each run's settled canvas and is not a semantic geometry/native-reference fidelity check. Request/API and host load spans are not isolated renderer CPU phases. GPU buffer bytes are estimates, not VRAM; sampled process values are not continuous OS peak. Dev runs are diagnostic and cannot be accepted as production release. This browser condition does not establish mobile or native AutoCAD parity.
